verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee renders pages in headless browsers by default and offers anti-blocking tiers: `premium_proxy` to 'bypass difficult to scrape websites', a `stealth_proxy` option, and `mode=auto` escalation through a cost ladder. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated undetected or stealth browser mode, and stealth_proxy appears only in passing as a limitation note. missing for 10: an explicit undetected-browser or fingerprint-evasion mode, documentation of how stealth_proxy defeats sophisticated bot detection, any independent or hands-on evidence of bypass success
